source: GitHub (zwh8800/recalbox-saves, a personal backup of Recalbox and handheld RetroArch save folders)
author: zwh8800 (commits signed wastecat / zzz)
what_it_is: League Bowling MVS backup RAM written by libretro MAME 2010 on a Recalbox; game state unknown
attribution: from the repo path only: 'saves/mame/mame2010/nvram/lbowling.nv'. The 'mame2010' folder is the save subdirectory that core creates; nothing else on the page names the core or the game state
note: 8192 bytes, every 16-bit word byte-swapped (ABKCPUR MAO  K at 0x10), the same form the played mame-2010 entries have
